source_english.description: Clean begins with the barbell near the legs, uses a powerful extension, and receives the load at the shoulders with soft knees.
instructions: Start with the barbell in front of the legs and brace the trunk.
Drive through the floor or hips to bring the load close to the body.
Receive it at the shoulders with soft knees and elbows under the load.
Lower it under control and reset before the next repetition.

Receive it at the shoulders with soft knees and elbows under the load.
Lower it under control and reset before the next repetition.
